items.title: Strong M6.8 earthquake hits Kepulauan Barat Daya, Indonesia, near Timor-Leste
items.summary: A strong earthquake registered by the USGS as M6.8 struck 103 km NE of Lospalos, Timor-Leste, at 09:42:10 UTC on November 21, 2026. The USGS is reporting a depth of 143.4 km (89 miles). EMSC is reporting M6.8 at a depth of 144 km (89.5 miles), locating the event in Kepulauan Barat Daya, Indonesia. There is no tsunami threat from this earthquake. Source

items.title: A broad low over southeastern Florida and the northwestern Bahamas has a 30 percent chance of subtropical or tropical development within 48 hours and a 50 percent chance within 7 days, the National Hurricane Center says
items.summary: The National Hurricane Center said a broad low over southeastern Florida, the northwestern Bahamas and adjacent waters has a 30 percent chance of becoming a subtropical or tropical cyclone within 48 hours and a 50 percent chance within 7 days. Gusty winds, dangerous surf and coastal flooding are expected along the Southeast and mid-Atlantic into early next week, regardless of development. Source
